title: Yellow Pages Egypt business record
description: One flat record per captured profile. Scalar fields are plain; structured fields are JSON-encoded strings (the platform indexes/dedupes by hashing values, which fails on nested lists/dicts). Consumers json.loads the *_json string fields. Parent records carry branches_json (each branch has its own detail); flat branch records carry branch_of and omit socials/branches.

from_category.description: Provenance: the category slug this record was reached through.

branch_of.description: Present only on flat branch records: the parent profile_id.

scraped_at.description: ISO timestamp set in-page at capture.

whatsapp.description: JSON string: array of WhatsApp links.

images.description: JSON string: array of gallery CDN image URLs (capture only).

socials.description: JSON string: array of company social URLs (parent records only).

website.description: JSON string: array of website URLs.

sections.description: JSON string: {sectionTitle: text} (About Us, Company Description, Search Words, ...).

branches.description: Parent records only. JSON string: [{name, profile_id, url, detail}] — each branch has its own nested detail (slimmed: no socials, no nested branches).
